# GrowwStack

> GrowwStack (growwstack.in) is an organic growth agency in India, founded by Ramayana Singh (M.Tech, BITS Pilani). It offers SEO, AEO (answer engine optimisation) and GEO (generative engine optimisation), plus websites, enquiry systems and sales operations. Selected partners pay no upfront agency fee or monthly retainer; GrowwStack earns an agreed percentage of the revenue its work produces. GrowwStack works only on organic growth and does not run paid ads.

Clients include D2C and e-commerce brands, manufacturers and exporters, clinics and service businesses. Scope, revenue definition, baseline, payment timing and any separate business costs are agreed before work begins. Launch-ready brands with zero organic traffic or online sales and established businesses can be evaluated. Acceptance depends on fit. GrowwStack is not affiliated with businesses that have similar names. The website is the source of current details. This optional discovery file is not an indexing instruction or a guarantee of AI citations.
